cases.description: Categorical x-axis, implicit y domain derived from both bar and line data, axis titles, and two titled series.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
xychart-beta
title "Category defaults"
x-axis "Quarter" [Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4]
y-axis "Revenue"
bar "Actual" [12, 18, 15, 27]
line "Forecast" [10, 20, 17, 25]
~~~

cases.description: Categorical x-axis, explicit y domain, bar and line series, quoted per-point labels, and visible bar labels outside the bars.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
%%{init: {"xyChart": {"showDataLabel": true, "showDataLabelOutsideBar": true}}}%%
xychart-beta
title "Weekly, signals"
x-axis "Day" [Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu]
y-axis "Index" 0 --> 100
bar "Visits" [20 "twenty", 35 "thirty five", 53 "fifty three", 72 "seventy two"]
line "Retention" [15 "low", 49 "rising", 57 "peak", 84 "high"]
~~~

cases.description: Numeric x/y domains with negative and positive values in both a line and a bar series.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
xychart-beta
title "Delta by week"
x-axis "Week" -2 --> 2
y-axis "Change" -20 --> 40
bar "Net" [-10, 5, -2, 12, 25]
line "Trend" [-12, 8, 3, 21, 29]
~~~

cases.description: No axis declarations; x coordinates are generated from the data count and y domain is inferred from the line series.
Horizontal orientation with numeric sample coordinates, a nonnegative value domain, bars and a line series, and outside data labels.
cases.source:
~~~mermaid
%%{init: {"xyChart": {"showDataLabel": true, "showDataLabelOutsideBar": true}}}%%
xychart-beta horizontal
title "Horizontal numeric"
x-axis "Sample" -2 --> 2
y-axis "Value" 0 --> 60
bar "Magnitude" [12, 18, 34, 50]
line "Reference" [8, 14, 29, 43]
~~~

cases.description: Fixed Mermaid chart dimensions and explicit domains recorded across narrow and wide viewports, with rotated numeric tick labels.

xychart-beta
title "Fixed canvas"

y-axis "Requests per minute" 0 --> 80
bar "Requests" [12, 22, 31, 48, 55, 43, 67, 72]
~~~
